svg.text: 2 — full Stage-1 and validation-led Stage-2 policy learning curves
Six imperfect domains; lines are seed means and translucent envelopes are full seed ranges. Stage 2 starts from each seed's validation-selected Stage-1 checkpoint.
Stage 1: n=10 per cell. Stage 2: available validation-led refinement trajectories; min–max bands show heterogeneity, not a confidence interval.
